svg.aria-label: D11 Suite, plan and entitlement architecture
svg.title: D11 Suite, plan and entitlement architecture
svg.text: COMMERCIAL ENTITLEMENT — WHAT THE ORGANISATION BOUGHT
USER AUTHORISATION — WHAT THIS PERSON MAY DO
One subscription per org per suite; two current subscriptions in the same suite = AMBIGUOUS → deny. Resolved on every request, no cache, no JWT claims.
Foreign ids return 404 (no existence oracle). Deactivation or role removal takes effect on the next request.
D11 · SUITE → PLAN → SUBSCRIPTION → ENTITLEMENT, AND USER AUTHORISATION
